chapter: Regal Theatre and the changing music scene
title: Eight years at the Regal Theatre
summary: He led the Regal Theatre house band from about 1962 to 1970, backing shows with Miles Davis, Jimmy Smith and Dick Gregory as MC.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: And then after that, then I went into the Regal, the Regal Theatre. And so -- and to stay here, it was about eight years.
I didn't know it was that long.
I didn't realize it was that long.
Yeah, it was that long. I was in there eight years.
Well, no, I went in there around '62, '61 or '62, and I stayed in there until about '70.
Yeah, I was in town then. Yeah, I remember going to the Regal. They'd have occasional jazz shows.
Miles Davis, right, right, and Jimmy Smith, right.
Dick Gregory was MC, that's the first time I heard Dick Gregory.
Yeah, right, right. But, see, this is what I say, when you get on the beginning of peoples' careers. So many beautiful musicians and things. And then --
